dct_title_s: Fremont County, Iowa, 1966, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKA. Form of individual image numbering: BKA-1GG-[number], or BKA-2GG-[number]. "Year Flown 1966". Flown by Park Aerial Surveys, Inc. Louisville, K.Y. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
